adrs.title: Consolidate IP Corp knowledge into single knowledge-base repo
Implement Purview as the parallel governance layer for Fabric
Use Teams as canonical meeting evidence when sources overlap
Gold domain semantic model as the reporting control surface
Plant-floor evidence stream contract before Traceability Gold
adrs.decider: Patrick / Plant Ops / R&D / MES → ratification

candidates.topic: **Custom data-migration tooling deprecated → Fabric Data Factory** as canonical ingestion runtime. Architectural lock-in to Fabric-native ELT. Captures the rationale for retiring legacy migration scripts.

**Informatica vs. Fabric-native MDM.** Robin Virginia opened a Salesforce/Informatica vendor channel positioning Informatica as "Source of Truth Engine" complementary to Fabric. Decision needed: evaluate, decline, or formally non-pursue.
**Fabric Foundation for Execution Brief** — capture the strategic framing decisions (Purview-in-parallel recommendation, "hard calls" section).

**Purview Advisory engagement model (CDW external partner)** — formalize the working relationship: CDW as named external partner for Purview/MDM/governance, distinct from Robin Virginia as individual consultant. SOW PO-004-9015989 signed 2026-05-04.

**M3 Cloud → Microsoft Fabric ingestion path** — replace multi-hop (M3 Cloud → Infor Data Fabric → on-prem SQL Server → MS Fabric) with either a direct Infor-Fabric → MS-Fabric connector or M3-Cloud → MS-Fabric direct, pending connector research. Eliminates two unnecessary hops and an on-prem dependency.

**SQL Server → Fabric Bronze mirroring as default ingestion pattern** — adopt Fabric's real-time SQL Server mirroring/sync (log-shipping-like) for all SQL-Server-backed sources, replacing recurring pipelines. Subject to per-table indexing/PK confirmation and network prerequisites validation with Stuart + Michael Kent.

**MES scope expansion: bring pilot reactor + experimental R&D batches under MES tracking** — close the new-product-introduction traceability gap (pilot reactor batches today created manually by Andre, materials drawn down manually, no soft-allocation in M3). Decision required because the change touches MES configuration, M3 inventory policy, and R&D workflow.

**System-of-record for CIPP submittal-package documentation** — current thumb-drive-only storage is an unacceptable single-point-of-failure for ~$20K-per-system test investments and contractually-required customer documentation. Decision needed on Optiva vs. document-management platform vs. Fabric-governed store.

**Batch lineage aggregation from PLC tank-transfer log** — design a Bronze→Silver model that reconstructs commingled-tank composition over time so traceability lookups ("which batches went into S-24 last quarter?") are possible. PLC already writes batch + product on every transfer; data is there, aggregation is not.

**Digitization of paper batch charge sheets** — paper is currently the legal record for batch composition (≥15 lot numbers per batch, manually recorded). MES captures only a subset. Decision needed on whether to digitize at point-of-charge or accept paper-as-legal-record indefinitely; impacts MDM scope.

**Sales semantic-model consolidation / canonical measure contract** — Sales BI models across Interplastic, MP, and NAC are cloned enough to share a semantic pattern but have same-name divergent DAX. Decision needed on one shared model with RLS vs governed per-company templates with canonical measures.

**Shared master-data relationship pattern for intercompany item/customer/supplier modeling** — May 20 intercompany mapping favored stable master records with maintained contextual relationships over duplicated company-specific masters. Needs M3-owner validation before full ADR.

**Plant-floor evidence stream contract before Traceability Gold** — formalize the May 19/26 plant-floor source-of-record insight as a prerequisite pattern: MES, paper charge sheets, PLC transfer logs, lab notebooks, CIPP packages, Optiva, Salesforce LSRs, QC, retains/rework, and NIR remain separate evidence streams until owner/location/authority/digital coverage are explicit.
